_comment: Claude Code. Traced from icons/claudecode-color.svg at 13x8 — the mark is already pixel art on a 24-unit grid, so it reduces without a fight, which the old radial burst never did. At this size the eyes, side arms and four legs all survive. Wider than tall on purpose: 32x8 has width to spare and no height, so a 13x8 mark uses the panel's actual shape. Brand orange #D97757.
